title: Iphepha Lemibuzo Yempilo Yomuntu - 9
instructions: Emavikini amabili adluleyo, uke waphazanyiswa kangaki yilezinkinga ezilandelayo?

questions.text: Ukulahlekelwa yintshisekelo loba intokozo ekwenzeni izinto
Ubunzima bokulala, ukuhlala ulele, loba ukulala kakhulu
Ukungabi lesifiso sokudla loba ukudla kakhulu
Ukuzizwa kubi ngawe loba sengathi wehlise wena loba umndeni wakho
Ubunzima bokugxila ezintweni ezifana lokufunda loba ukubukela ithelevishini
Ukuhamba loba ukukhuluma kancane kakhulu abantu bakubone, loba ukuphambana lalokho ungahlaliseki kakhulu kulokujwayelekile
Imicabango yokuthi kungaba ngcono uba ubufile loba uzilimaze
